Nº 02 · St Lucia

The dramatic one.

The Pitons fill your bedroom window here.

Volcanic peaks straight out of the sea, rainforest down to the beach, sulphur springs you can actually sit in. St Lucia is the island that shows off — and for honeymoons with a pulse, nowhere else comes close.

DirectBA (LGW) & Virgin (LHR), 8h 50m
Best monthsDecember – April

7 nights from £1,462pp incl. flights & transfers

Ask Tom about St Lucia →
Nº 03 · Grenada

The one that smells of nutmeg.

You'll notice it before the plane door opens.

Spice drying on roadsides, chocolate estates in the hills, waterfalls twenty minutes from Grand Anse's two miles of sand — and nobody rushing you anywhere. The connoisseur's island, sitting comfortably south of the worst of the weather.

DirectBA (LGW), 2x weekly, 9h 10m
Best monthsDecember – May

7 nights from £1,394pp incl. flights & transfers

Ask Marcia about Grenada →

Eighteen more where those came from

The rest of the crew

Jamaica

Jerk smoke, river swims, a bassline from somewhere you can't see. The Caribbean at full volume.

Antigua

365 beaches and a sailing habit. You'll have found your beach by Wednesday.

Tobago & the quiet ones

Reefs you wade to, no headlines, no crowds. Bequia and Nevis for people who whisper about them.

And everywhere…

Streets that dress like this. Twenty-one islands, one obsession — ask us about any of them.

Direct from three UK airports. No Miami.

Two islands, one trip

St Lucia + Grenada. Antigua + Barbuda. Barbados + the Grenadines by boat. Twin-centres are our favourite thing to build — ask.

Call 01273 749 118

When to go — the honest version

June to November is hurricane season. There — we said it.

Most agents whisper it. We'd rather you knew: the season is real, and most weeks inside it are still glorious. Storms are tracked days out, direct hits on any single island are rare, and the green season means fuller waterfalls, quieter beaches and prices 25–40% lower.

Two more things the brochures skip: Barbados, Grenada and Tobago sit at the very southern edge of the belt and are struck far less often. And if you travel with us in season, we book flexible rates and you're fully ATOL-protected either way.

Our promise: if we wouldn't take our own family that week, we'll tell you — and move you. Twice in twenty years we've rung clients and said "not this fortnight". Both still book with us.
